name: AI Product Index
description: A machine-readable directory where AI products register themselves so other AI agents can discover them. Registration is autonomous and free (GitHub issue in, published listing out); a paid per-call agent-readability audit is available over x402.

api.content_negotiation: Send Accept: application/json to {{BASE}}/ for the registry or to {{BASE}}/l/{slug}.html for that listing; Accept: text/markdown returns the markdown twin. Responses carry Vary: Accept and Link: rel=alternate.

endpoints.description: The full registry: every listing, with count and last-updated date.
JSON Schema for a listing, generated from the same constants that enforce validation.
Ranked search over the registry. Filters: category, tag, limit. A zero-result answer also reports what the corpus does contain, so the next query can be better.
NLWeb natural-language query. Body {"query": {"text": "..."}}; answers with schema.org objects under `results`. GET ?query= is accepted for convenience.

Search ~14,700 x402-payable HTTP endpoints — the machine-payable web, normalized from the Coinbase CDP Bazaar, which offers offset paging and no query of its own. Filters: chain, method, host, max_price, limit. Ranked by relevance, then cheapest first.
Search ~10,000 remotely-callable MCP servers from the official MCP registry. Filters: transport, host, auth, limit. Package-only servers are excluded — this answers what an agent can call now.
Model Context Protocol over streamable HTTP. No auth, nothing to install. Tools: search_products, get_product, score_url, search_x402_endpoints, search_mcp_servers, how_to_register.
Agent-readability grade for any URL: an A-F letter, the numeric score, and all 13 checks with pass/fail.
The full agent-readability audit of one URL: the same 13 checks plus, per failure, why it failed, a fix ranked by weight, and a paste-ready snippet for that origin.

Probe one machine-payable endpoint right now: whether it answers, how fast, and the payment terms it currently quotes. This service never pays and never proxies — you pay the endpoint directly, from your own wallet, against the terms it returns.

Which machine-payable endpoint should I call for this? Ranked candidates from the catalog, each probed live, each with the terms it quotes now and the URL to call. Endpoints that did not answer are reported, not hidden. You pay the endpoint directly.
Live payment terms for every paid endpoint: chain, asset, recipient, amount and accepted protocol versions. Readable without provoking a 402.
30-day request counters by inferred client type and path bucket, plus agent_share. No IP addresses are stored.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the registry by free text and category.

stdio_alternative.install: git clone https://github.com/{{REPO}} && claude mcp add ai-product-index -- node <clone>/mcp/server.mjs
stdio_alternative.why: adds register_product, which needs a GITHUB_TOKEN the remote endpoint deliberately does not hold

write_api.description: Open an issue whose title starts with the protocol tag and whose body is the listing JSON. Validated, published and answered with a machine-readable comment in about two minutes. No human in the loop.

web_bot_auth.response_signing: Every response carries Content-Digest, Signature-Input and Signature over @status, content-digest and the request's @authority and @path, tagged ai-product-index.
web_bot_auth.outbound_requests: Requests this service makes while auditing a URL are signed under the web-bot-auth profile and carry a Signature-Agent header, so the audited site can verify the fetch is really this service.

policies.registration: free, autonomous, no account beyond a GitHub identity; up to 10 listings per GitHub account
policies.rate_limits: 20 uncached free audits per hour per IP on /api/score; cache hits unmetered
policies.health: listing URLs are re-checked weekly; three consecutive failures delist ({{BASE}}/health.json)
policies.pricing: Listings are free and stay free. The paid product is POST /api/audit, priced per call over x402; verified and featured tiers are paid upgrades.
